item.title: Leitrim GAA launch 50 miles fundraising event
item.description: A launch event took place on Wednesday evening in Carrick-on-Shannon for the Leitrim GAA 50 miles fundraising. The fundraiser which first launched in 2021 invites participants to take part using the slogan “walk, run or connect”. The fundraising event invites people to walk or run while connecting with Leitrim supporters both at home and abroad. item.title: WATCH: Hundreds line Carrick's streets as Santa arrives to switch on lights
item.description: Hundreds of people were in Carrick-on-Shannon tonight to watch Santa switch on the Christmas lights. There was a Christmas Lights Parade from the fire station down to the Market Yard beforehand. There were banners to reflect Carrick's success in the SuperValu TidyTowns competition recently, where it won the overall award. item.title: Emergency services attend fatal house fire in Co. Offaly
item.description: Emergency services have attended the scene of a housefire which has claimed lives in Co. Offaly. Fire crews were called to the blaze at a family home in Edenderry yesterday evening and managed to put out the blaze. However its understood the house was occupied at the time, and one or more people may have died. The scene has been sealed off. Advertisement

item.title: Murder investigation underway into Offaly house fire
item.description: A murder investigation is underway after a woman in her 60s and a four-year-old boy died in a house fire in Offaly. It broke out at a home in Castleview Park in Edenderry at about 7.45 yesterday evening. Another woman, aged in her 50s, is in hospital with serious injuries. The house has been declared a crime scene and Garda technical examinations are ongoing, with post mortems due to begin this afternoon at Midland Regional Hospital Tullamore. item.title: Longford councillor calls for safety signs to be erected on two county roads
item.description: A Longford councillor has called for safety signs to be erected on two roads in the county. Fine Gael's Martin Skelly raised the issue at this week's Ballymahon Municipal District meeting. He wants to see works carried out on the Ballymahon to Newtowncashel road and the Corlea to Kenagh village road. Longford County Council confirmed at the meeting that the two routes are on the road upgrades programme next year. Cllr Skelly says parts of the roads are dangerous: Advertisement

item.title: Leitrim club calling for GAA to drop Allianz as sponsor over Israel ties
item.description: A Co. Leitrim club is calling for the GAA to drop Allianz as a sponsor over its ties to Israel. Sean O'Heslins' club in Ballinamore will be bringing forward the motion at the county board's convention in two weeks' time. A recent UN report claimed Allianz is benefiting financially from Israeli forces being in Gaza. Roscommon, Offaly, Tyrone and Fermanagh county boards have all passed the motion. Allianz has been a leading sponsor of the GAA's National Leagues since 1993. Advertisement

item.title: Funeral arrangements announced for ex-minister Paddy Cooney
item.description: The funeral of former cabinet minister Paddy Cooney, from Griffith Street, Athlone, is taking place on Thursday. The Longford-Westmeath politician served as minister in the cabinets of Liam Cosgrave and Garrett Fitzgerald. He also was an MEP and senator for Fine Gael. item.title: Connacht collapse to Ospreys defeat
item.description: Connacht let a 21 point lead slip to suffer defeat to Ospreys in their opening Challenge Cup game. Connacht charged out of the traps with Finlay Bealham and Sean Jansen touching down inside 17 minutes. Sean Naughton converted both. Jack Aungier 23rd minute try with Naughton’s additional two saw Connacht lead 21-0. However, it was the visitor’s last score of the day.
